start.timing_scope: job start through ARM, preparation, complete validation, producer drain, DISARM and session cleanup; USB and LCD excluded
start.per_direction_scope: All attempted synchronous transfer calls only, including failed call; excludes producer preparation and reply validation; job_MBps is complete successful job metric
start.dma_activity_scope: Cumulative module/driver counter differences before ARM/session begin through session end/DISARM; null if hook absent or counter reset detected
start.wait_scope: Measured blocking call wall durations, including scheduler wake latency; overlap across workers, not subtracted from wall to infer CPU
start.runtime_granularity: End snapshot follows taskYIELD; scheduler runtime counter resolution and snapshot overhead apply; final return-to-wait tail is not represented
start.cpu_scope: FreeRTOS task runtime counter deltas for producer and consumer; ESP_TIMER microseconds required; one-core equivalent worker activity/wall, not whole-chip CPU; ISR may be charged to scheduled task; excludes USB/display
